Commentary.Commentary: That's a wrap to this game. It will be a quick turnaround for the next ODI, after a break of just one day. On Thursday, 31st March 2022, these two teams will collide again in Lahore at 3.30 pm IST (10 am GMT). You can tune in early for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Aaron Finch, the victorious skipper, says that they were looking to score somewhere around 300 and eventually they got it in the end. Adds that Travis Head got off to a flier and that helped them. Tells that Pakistan bowled well in the middle overs and at the backend as well. Feels that it was very hard to bowl with the wet ball but the bowlers managed it really well. Says that the batters who are set need to ensure that they cash in and score big.

Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan, says that they conceded too many runs at the start and although they made a comeback, they ended up giving a few runs extra. He considers his wicket as the turning point and says that when you lose back-to-back wickets in a chase, it becomes tough. Mentions that they gave opportunities to Mohammad Wasim and Zahid Mahmood and they did a reasonable job, although the execution of plans with the ball could have been better. Tells that they will sit down and discuss their mistakes and hopes that they don't repeat the same.

Travis Head (101 off 72 balls, 2 for 35) is the unanimous choice for the Player of the Match. Says that he wanted to make full use of his opportunity while batting at the top and he is glad that it came off. Adds that they were aware of the dew and hence, they wanted to get as many runs as possible. Mentions that he has been working hard on his bowling and it feels nice to get some wickets.
Umpire Aleem Dar, who has officiated in over 500 international games now, is presented with a special memento. He accepts it with a smile on his face.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Adam Zampa (10-0-38-4) says that the batters set the game nicely for them. Adds that there was a bit of dew but they bowled well. Tells that they do a lot of research on the opposition and he is glad that his plan worked in this game. Mentions that the ball was coming onto the bat nicely but there was also some spin on offer. Applauds Travis Head by saying that he is very happy for Head and it was a match-winning knock from the southpaw.

It's a great match for Adam Zampa. The leggie bowled with great control and guile, mixing his lengths and pace judiciously and picked up four wickets in the match. His partner Mitchell Swepson also contributed two wickets and another man who picked up two wickets was Travis Head who didn't put a single step wrong on the field. Here is Adam Zampa giving a quick interview...

Australia's bowling was as professional as their batting, one can say. They maintained good pressure in Powerplay 1 and even when Babar and Imam were amidst a partnership, the Aussies hung in there, looking to dry out the runs and create opportunities. Mitchell Swepson's maiden ODI wicket was of Babar Azam and that opened one end for the touring team. The wickets started to tumble at regular intervals and Imam kept losing partners. The required rate started to mount pressure and then there was a brief period when Imam upped his strike rate and found a few boundaries. However, soon after completing his hundred, he was cleaned up by Nathan Ellis, yet another debutant and that was that for Pakistan.

When Australia were batting, at one stage, a score around 350 looked certain. But they lost the plot after the 30th over, and everyone thought that they left a few runs out there in the field. A target of 314 though was always going to be challenging on any surface and in any conditions as you always have to bat by keeping the required rate in mind. Losing Fakhar Zaman early was a big setback for Pakistan but the stand between Imam-ul-Haq and Babar Azam kept their chances afloat with a 96-run stand.

A commanding victory for Australia and they have taken an early lead in the ODI series along with crucial 10 points for the ICC World Cup Super League. It was a neat and perfect performance from a new-look Australian unit, short on experience but not on quality. Almost all the players, who don't get opportunities in the first-choice team, approached this game with open arms and displayed the depth of the squad. Travis Head's scintillating hundred set the tone, Ben McDermott navigated the middle phase with his refreshing approach and then Cameron Green provided the late flourish. Australia will be immensely pleased and satisfied with the work of the batting group.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is it! The debutant, Mitchell Swepson gets the last wicket and Pakistan are bowled out for 225! A loopy full toss, on middle. Rauf comes down the track and looks to clear long on. He does not time it well though and the ball goes high in the air. Cameron Green is there in the deep and takes a simple catch without moving an inch. Australia win by 88 runs!
Commentary.Howout: c Cameron Green b Mitchell Swepson

Commentary.Commentary: Play and a miss! Tossed up, outside off. Haris Rauf looks to slog-sweep but he fails to make any connection.
A slower ball, on a length, around off. Zahid Mahmood dabs it onto the deck.
Short of a length, around off. Zahid Mahmood keeps it out.
Shorter in length, outside off. Haris Rauf throws his bat at it. It goes off the outer half towards deep cover for one run.
Ellis hits the deck hard, around off. Haris Rauf looks to heave it away but it goes off the top edge and lands safely wide of the mid off fielder.
No ball! A beamer, way down leg. Rauf does not offer any shot to it. The umpire calls it no ball for height. Free Hit to follow.
FOUR! WHACKED! That is a shot and a half from Rauf! On a length, around middle. Rauf sits back and smashes it back past the bowler through mid on and it races away to the fence.
Back of a length, around off. Rauf covers the line of the ball and blocks it.
A yorker, around off. Zahid Mahmood digs it out.
Wide! This is a wayward ball, down leg. Mahmood misses his flick. Wided!
Full and outside off. Rauf drills it to long off for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Haris Rauf looks to sweep but he gets a thick inside edge onto his pad.
Around off. Blocked out.
Zahid Mahmood is the number 11 batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Khushdil Shah tries to go big but ends up hitting high in the air, without any distance. This a googly, on a fuller length, outside off and turning away late. Khushdil Shah kneels and looks for a slog-sweep. It takes the top edge and goes high in the night sky towards the short cover region. Alex Carey calls for it from behind the sticks, runs there and pouches it safely. Australia are just 1 wicket away from a win now.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Tosses it up, outside off. Khushdil Shah drags it to long off for a single.
Around off, on a length, Haris Rauf defends it from the back foot.
A yorker around leg, angling down, Rauf fails to keep it out and is hit on the back leg. The bowler appeals for an lbw but that's missing leg. In fact, the impact is also outside.
Short and on off, Shah punches it from the back foot to deep cover for a single.
Slower one, on a length and around leg, it's eased behind square leg for a run.
Wide! Fuller and angling down the leg side, Haris tries to flick but misses.
Sharp delivery at 136 clicks, on a length and around off, Rauf defends it from the back foot.
Back of a length, around middle and leg, Shah turns it in the gap at mid-wicket and runs the first run hard. That's all he will get.
Flatter leg spinner around off, Rauf gets back and taps it down to covers. Looks for a run but Shah sends him back.
Fullish and on off, driven back to the bowler.
Zampa goes for a quicker one, short and on middle, Rauf stands back and defends it down.
Haris Rauf walks out to bat. He will face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Stumps are shattered and that's 100 ODI wickets for Adam Zampa! A special moment for the young leggie. He slows it up in the air and brings out his googly for the new batter. Lands it around off, Mohammad Wasim has no idea what's cooking there. He gets forward to defend but it beats the inside half of his bat and goes on to tickle the top of the off stump. The end is near for Pakistan. Zampa is on a hat-trick!
Mohammad Wasim is the new batter in.

OUT! Clattered! Adam Zampa decides to fire in a short ball. It's quite quick and short around leg, skidding off the surface, Hasan Ali steps back to pull but the ball stays low and beats his bat. It makes contact with the leg stump and Pakistan lose their 7th wicket.
Googly, short and outside off, punched to deep cover for a run.
Adam Zampa (8-0-35-1) is back on.
A dipping yorker around leg, Hasan digs it out on the surface. What a magnificent over, just 2 from it. 102 needed off 54 balls.

Mixing up his pace nicely. Goes slower again, on a length around off, Shah taps it down to covers and pinches a run. The fielder misses his shy at the striker's end, Hasan looks for an overthrow but is sent back.
Beaten! Superbly bowled. Seam up from Ellis as he angles across a length ball outside off, Shah pushes inside the line and misses.
Slower again, short and on off, staying low, Hasan eases it behind square leg for one.
Clever change in pace, short again, around off, Hasan is way too early with his attempted cross-batted shot and misses.
Swing and a miss! Short in length and on off, Hasan winds up for a big heave over the leg side but misses.
Time for Powerplay 3! Australia can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the ring till the end.
FOUR! Hammered away! Shah gets hold of this shot and finds the fence. Shortish and on off, Khushdil latches onto it and powers it over mid on for a boundary. 104 needed off 60 balls.
Hasan finds one in his range, he heaves a length ball over mid-wicket for a run, opens his account.
Around off, on a length, Hasan once again plays it down from the back foot to point.
Lands it on a length and close to off, it's tapped down to point by Hasan.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and helps it to mid-wicket.
Slower one, short and on off at 127.1 kph, Shah takes his eyes off the ball and plays a reactive pull shot down to fine leg for a run.
Hasan Ali walks out to bat.

OUT! DEATH RATTLE! The crowd has gone silent. Imam's stay is over and that possibly is the final nail in the coffin as Pakistan still need 110 runs off 66 balls. Nathan Ellis comes up with a magical delivery, a near-yorker at 134.4 kph, Imam moves around inside the crease, steps back to make room for a drive but fails to keep this one out. The stumps are obliterated and Ellis jumps in joy. A quick pat on the back for Imam by Alex Carey and Australia are back on top now after a small period of pressure.

In the air but evades the fielder. Back of a length, around middle and leg, Imam steps back and punches it through the line. It's uppish but wide of the cover fielder inside the ring. A couple of runs.
Follows the batter down the leg side with a length ball, around middle and leg at 138 kph, Imam defends it from the crease to point.
Imam-ul-Haq gets his gloves changed.
Off pace, short and on off, Shah pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller and close to off, Khushdil mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
Slower in pace, short and angling down, Imam works it down to fine leg and looks for two. He gets only a run.
Nathan Ellis (4-0-20-0) is back into the attack.

CENTURY FOR IMAM! His 8th in ODIs! What a comeback he is having! A century in the first Test and now a ton in the first ODI. His job is not done though as Pakistan are in a precarious situation - 114 needed off 72 balls. Back of a length, around middle, Imam-ul-Haq closes the face and works it through square leg for a single. He raises his bat to celebrate his hundred but needs to get his composure back quickly.

Fuller in length and outside off, slower in pace, Shah throws his bat at it and drags it off the inner edge. The mid on fielder moves across to his left, tries to go down low and stop it but misses. Three runs taken.
Pitches it up and outside off, Imam strokes it to deep cover and takes a run. Moves to 99!
Slower one, short and close to off, Imam tries to run it down to third man but it pings him on the gloves and rolls away to point.
Uppish but safe! Short and on off, Shah plays a mistimed pull shot and it goes over the fielder at mid-wicket. One run is taken.
Abbott begins his new spell from 'round the wicket and angles in a good-length delivery around off, Shah stays back and helps it to mid-wicket.
Sean Abbott (5-0-24-1) is back on.
Flighted and full, outside off, Imam tries to drive it off his front foot but mistimes it back to the bowler. 10 from this over, 23 in the last two. 120 needed off 78 balls.
Googly around leg, Shah keeps it out in front of square leg and steals a quick run.
Short and on off, Imam gets back and cuts it to deep cover for a run. Moves to 98!
Loopy and full, around middle, Shah flicks it through mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Quicker through the air, short and around leg, Imam works it to deep square leg for one.
SIX! Imam gives the charge and sends it flying over long off. Moves to 96. Full and floated, around leg, Imam hands it the full whack of his bat and gets a maximum.
Darts it in, full and on off, Imam drives it down to long off and retains strike. 13 from the over, 130 needed off 84 balls.
Serves it full and around leg, Imam flicks it in the gap at mid-wicket and comes back for the second run. Good awareness of the field shown by Imam.
FOUR! Imam is trying his best to keep this chase alive. Too full and on middle, Imam goes down on one knee and heaves it cleanly over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up, around middle, defended back.
Fuller and around leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
SIX! High and handsome! Head drops it short and on off, Imam picks the length in a flash,  goes deep inside the crease and pulls it all the way over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Bowls this one with a quick-arm action, short and outside off, Imam camps back and cuts it through covers for a single. The asking rate is now 9.5.
Flatter through the air, a bit short and on leg, Shah flicks it past the mid-wicket fielder for one.
Full and around leg, Imam gets back and eases it down to long leg for a run.
Spinning away from the batter, from around off, Shah plays late and places it wide of backward point for a single.
Swepson pushes it quicker through the air, around middle, Shah goes back and defends it towards the bowler.
Nicely flighted, full and around leg, Shah flicks but finds mid-wicket.
Little bit of grip on this delivery, around off and spinning away, Imam plays late, almost off the outside edge but finds short third man.
Drags his length short again, this time Shah chops his attempted cut wide of point and takes a single.
Short and outside off, cut from the back foot to point.
Khushdil Shah walks out to bat.

OUT! Iftikhar holes out and it's a tremendous catch from Sean Abbott in the deep. Head has two and he continues to have a fantastic match. Flighted delivery, landing full and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed shimmies down the track and aims to clear long on. He times it decently and it's destined to go for a biggie. But Sean Abbott, near the fence, times his jump to perfection and plucks it out of thin air with both hands. Outstanding effort. Pakistan slip further and Imam-ul-Haq is running out of partners. 148 needed off 99 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Sean Abbott b Travis Head

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted this time, full and on off, Ahmed drives but finds the cover fielder.
Darts in a very full ball on off, Imam strokes it down to long off for a single.
Floated and full, outside off, Iftikhar drives it off the front foot but finds Head at backward point. 149 needed off 102 balls.
Quicker through the air, a bit short and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed goes back to punch but again gets an inside edge onto the pads.
A top spinner, landing full and around off, Ahmed tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Nicely tossed up, around off, Imam walks forward again and yorks himself. He somehow gets his bat down in time and digs it out to covers for a run.
FOUR! Imam has certainly tried to up the scoring ante since the fall of the last wicket. Too full and around off, Imam walks forward and whips it through square leg for a boundary.
Loopy and full, around leg, Ahmed nudges it behind square leg and calls for two. He gets only a run.
In the air and just over the fielder! A short ball, around leg. Imam-ul-Haq rocks back and mistimes his pull shot. The ball goes just over the mid-wicket fielder and the batters take two runs.
This is bowled slower through the air, full and outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed pushes it through the off side and takes a run. He gets off the mark.
A flatter ball, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed dabs it towards Aaron Finch at first slip.
A googly, on a length, around leg. Iftikhar Ahmed misses his flick and gets hit on his pad.
Darted on the pads. Imam-ul-Haq tucks it around the corner and settles for a run.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Tossed up, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq lofts it over the bowler's head and bags a boundary.

DRINKS! Australia have successfully navigated through the middle overs and picked up three wickets in the process, including Babar Azam's and Mohammad Rizwan's - the stalwarts of Pakistan's batting. The touring team holds the aces but cannot afford to relax. 163 needed off 114 balls.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Brilliant catch from Alex Carey behind the sticks. Australia are on top at the moment! Zampa serves a full ball, around leg. Rizwan looks to paddle it through fine leg but he only manages a slight tickle towards the keeper. Carey moves sharply towards his left and takes a fine catch. Pakistan are in deep trouble now as they lose their experienced batter in Rizwan. They still require 163 runs from 114 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter in length, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan cuts it to the cover fielder.
A short ball, on off. Mohammad Rizwan mistimes his pull shot towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Flatter ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq cuts it through covers and takes a run.
Floated, full and outside off. Mohammad Rizwan drives it to deep cover and rotates the strike.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Imam drives it down to long off and takes a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq cuts it to deep cover and takes a single.
This is a length ball, on middle. Mohammad Rizwan works it back past the bowler for a single.
Another ball that is full and on middle. Mohammad Rizwan pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and around middle. Imam squeezes it out towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan smothers the spin and works it to long on for a single.
On a length, around middle. Imam tucks it to mid-wicket for one run.
A full toss, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq runs down the track and eases it to long on for a single.
Shorter in length, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan cuts it wide of the deep point fielder and takes a single.
On a length, on middle. Rizwan tucks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan tries to cut but he misses.
Floated, full and outside off. Mohammad Rizwan looks to drive but it goes off the outer half towards backward point.
A full toss, on middle. Rizwan heaves it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder and takes a couple of runs.
Wide! A full ball, down leg. Rizwan misses his sweep. Wided!
Adam Zampa (5-0-21-0) comes back to bowl.
Good-length ball, around middle and leg. Mohammad Rizwan flicks it to the leg side and takes one run. 176 runs needed from 132 balls.
This is darted on the pads. Imam-ul-Haq nudges it around the corner and settles for a single.
Shorter in length, outside off. Rizwan guides it to third man and rotates the strike.
Short of a length, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan stands tall and punches it to the cover fielder.
Back of a length, angling in from outside off. Imam-ul-Haq steers it to third man for a single.
A length ball, around middle. Mohammad Rizwan pushes it towards mid on and scampers through to the other end.
This is darted on the pads. Rizwan tucks it around the corner and gets off the mark with a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Mohammad Rizwan keeps it out.
Mohammad Rizwan walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! A soft dismissal now and Pakistan lose their third wicket. Head serves a flatter ball, on a fuller length around off and spinning away a touch. Saud Shakeel prods and looks to flick it across the line but gets a leading edge. He ends up chipping it straight to Marnus Labuschagne at short extra cover who takes a sitter. Pakistan are in a slight spot of bother now. What a day Head is having! Top captaincy from Aaron Finch to bring him back into the attack against the two left-handers. 182 needed off 140 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Marnus Labuschagne b Travis Head

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full and outside off. Saud Shakeel works it towards backward point.
Floated, full and outside off. Saud Shakeel looks to sweep but he misses.
Imam comes down the track and cuts this wide ball towards deep point for one run.
Back of a length, just outside off. Saud Shakeel punches it back to the bowler.
Once again the line is around middle and leg. Imam tickles it to fine leg and hands the strike back to Shakeel.
A short ball, around leg. Saud Shakeel pulls it along the ground towards fine leg and collects a run.
Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Imam-ul-Haq glances it to fine leg and rotates the strike.
A full ball, on off. Saud Shakeel flicks it from the inner half of his blade towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, around leg. Saud Shakeel tucks it to mid-wicket.
A very full ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq drags it back to the bowler. 187 needed off 150 balls.
Flatter ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq taps it towards point.
SIX! BANG! Imam-ul-Haq gets to his FIFTY in some style! This is floated, full and on middle. Imam skips down the track yet again and smacks it way over long on for a maximum.
A quicker ball, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq skips down to slog but he misses and gets hit on his pad.
Tossed up, around leg. Saud Shakeel tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Saud Shakeel walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Mitchell Swepson gets the big fish and this is a huge wicket in the context of the game! A very full ball, around leg and spinning towards middle. Babar Azam looks to sweep but he misses and gets pinged low on his pad. Australia appeal and the umpire agrees. Babar opts for a review but the Ball Tracking indicates three reds and Babar is a goner! A wicket on debut for Mitchell Swepson and that too of Pakistan's skipper. Australia have finally broken the partnership and they are right back in this contest.
Fuller in length, outside off. Babar Azam drives it wide of Aaron Finch at mid off and collects a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Babar Azam punches it through the cover region and takes a couple of runs.
Good-length ball, on middle. Babar Azam works it towards mid on.
A length ball, around leg. Imam-ul-Haq tickles it to fine leg and the batters cross ends.
Back of a length, outside off. Imam shimmies down the track and looks to cut hard but he fails to make any connection.
A full ball, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq pushes it back to the bowler.
Nathan Ellis (2-0-12-0) comes back to bowl.

An appeal for LBW and the umpire says no! Australia have opted for a review though! This was a flatter ball, on a length, around off. Babar Azam prods to block and it seems like he got an inside edge onto his pad. The decision has been sent upstairs. The Ball Tracking rolls in and the TV umpire feels that the ball hit the bat directly and not the pad. The on-field decision remains. Australia burn their one review. They also check for a catch but the ball has clearly bounced off the deck before going to the keeper.
FOUR! That is a terrific shot from the Pakistan skipper! A googly, on a length, and spinning in from outside off. Babar stays back and cuts it past the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Full and on middle. Imam squeezes it out to long on and takes a single.
Floated, full and on middle. Babar Azam drills it to long on for a run. FIFTY for Babar Azam! His 18th ODI fifty! Good knock from him so far but the job is only half done.
Imam comes down the track so Swepson drags his length back, around middle. Imam nudges it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq skips down and tucks it towards Marnus at mid-wicket.

On a length and outside off. Babar Azam looks to push it through cover but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler. Although, Stoinis does not manage to pick the ball up cleanly and it rolls towards Imam.
Fuller in length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq drives it towards mid off and completes a quick single.
Back of a length, outside off. Babar pushes it towards mid off and manages to get a run. Babar moves to 49 now!
Drop and run! Short of a length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq taps it to backward point and takes a quick run.
Short of a length, on middle. Babar Azam stands tall and punches it down to long on. A single taken!
Good-length ball, outside off. Babar Azam looks to drive but it goes off the inner half towards mid on.
Tossed up, on middle. Imam nudges it to mid-wicket.
On a length, around leg. Babar Azam flicks it to the leg side and collects a run.

FOUR! Nicely played! This is a full ball, well outside off. Babar carves it through the cover region. Ben McDermott in the deep tries his best to stop the ball by diving to his right but the ball wins. A much-needed boundary for Pakistan!
This is flatter, around middle. Babar tucks it wide of the deep square leg fielder and comes back for the second run. 100 comes up for Pakistan!
Tossed up, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq reverse-sweeps it towards deep point. A single taken.
Babar comes down the track and eases this full ball to long on for a run.
Good-length delivery, angling in from 'round the wicket, around middle. Imam tucks it to mid-wicket. Just 1 run off the over!
On a length, around middle. Babar Azam pushes it towards mid on and scampers through to the other end.
Back of a length, on middle. Babar Azam nudges it to the mid-wicket fielder. Five dots in a row!
Pitches it up this time, outside off. Babar Azam drives but finds the cover fielder.
Marcus hits the deck hard, around middle. Babar Azam wrists it to the mid-wicket fielder, along the ground.
Back of a length, outside off. Babar Azam taps it towards the backward point fielder.
Slightly short and outside off. Imam-ul-Haq cuts it to the backward point fielder. Singles won't hurt Australia at this stage.
Floated, full and around middle. Babar Azam gets forward and strokes it towards long on. The batters cross ends.
On a length, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq eases it to long on and collects one run.
This is around leg. Babar Azam flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Flatter ball, around middle and turning in late. Babar manages to keep it out.
Tosses it up, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq drives it towards Marnus Labuschagne at extra cover who half-stops it with a dive to his left. The ball rolls towards mid off for a run.
Change in bowling. Travis Head to roll his arm now.
This is a length ball, darted on the pads. Imam-ul-Haq turns it towards deep mid-wicket and settles for only a single. A tidy start from Stoinis, 4 runs off the over!
Shorter in length, outside off. Babar Azam hangs back and slaps it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Pitches it up, on middle. Babar flicks but straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Short of a length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq stays back and steers it to third man for one run.
On a length, around middle. Babar tucks it to deep mid-wicket and hands the strike back to Imam.
Stoinis starts with a back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Babar Azam taps it towards backward point.

Drinks break. Slow but steady progress from Pakistan after losing Fakhar Zaman early. The ongoing stand between Babar Azam and Imam-ul-Haq has kept them afloat and they will be looking for this partnership to run deep in this chase. The required rate is not at all an issue and by preserving wickets, they can transfer the pressure on the Aussies. A very crucial middle phase is about to begin. 227 needed off 198 balls. There doesn't seem to be any dew at the moment but the Super Sopper is still at work, maybe pre-decided before the match. Here is Marcus Stoinis...
Tosses it up, outside off. Babar Azam drills it down to long off and retains the strike by taking a run.
This is a very full ball, outside off. Babar Azam works it towards extra cover.
Floated, around middle. Babar wrists it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Nicely played! A flatter ball, slightly short and around off. Babar Azam stays back and guides it past Travis Head at short third man for a boundary. Head though gave it a chase but to no avail.
Tossed up, around middle. Imam gets forward and tickles it through to fine leg for a single.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Babar Azam slices it to deep point and rotates the strike.
Babar runs down the track and pushes this full ball towards long on for a run.
Nicely tossed up, around middle. Babar Azam prods and defends it out solidly.
This is drifting onto the pads. Imam-ul-Haq tucks it around the corner and takes a single.
Around off, blocked out.
FOUR! A rare full toss, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq heaves it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Flatter ball, around middle. Babar Azam punches it down to long on for a single. That brings up the 50-run stand between these two!

Zampa tries to bowl a slider, it's short and around leg, staying a bit low, Babar gets back and drags his pull shot in front of square on the leg side. One run to end the over. 241 needed off 210 balls.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, Imam shows a straight bat and caresses it down to long on for a run.
A low full toss around off, Azam clips it to the right of long on and gets a single. Should have at least pushed for the second run.
Flatter this time, lands on middle and turns away a shade, Babar attempts to flick but gets a soft leading edge to the off side.
Extra loop on this delivery, Imam dances down the track to take it on the full and pushes it to long on for one.
Flatter and shorter, around middle and leg, Babar works it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
A touch short and on off, turning away, Babar goes on the back foot and punches it down to long off for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Imam rocks back to cut but finds the backward point fielder. Mitchell Swepson gets away there! Just a single.
A googly, landing full and around off, Imam gets forward and pushes it to covers.
Short and on off, Babar pulls it from the back foot, to the right of long on, and takes a single.
Slower through the air this time, full and on middle, Babar defends it back from the inner half of his blade.
Flatter through the air, full and on middle, Imam dances down the track and hits it to long on for one.
Slower through the air, full and around middle, Imam milks another single by flicking it to deep mid-wicket.
Flighted leg spinner around leg, Babar tucks it to square leg and takes a quick single. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but Babar is safe.
Tossed up, full and on off, Babar is forward in defense.
Loopy around leg, Imam eases it to long on and rotates the strike.
Presses forward and drives it firmly to deep cover for one.
Quicker one, full and on middle, blocked back.
Fuller again, on middle, knocked down to long on for a single. A decent start from Mitchell Swepson.
Loopy around middle and leg, full in length, Babar nudges it to mid-wicket.
Gets forward and again drives a full ball back to the bowler.
Floated and full around middle, defended back.

FOUR! Slapped away! This length will come with a leg spinner bowling. Short and wide outside off, Babar rocks back and whacks it to the deep point fence. 4000 ODI runs for Babar Azam - he is the second fastest to this mark, getting there in 82 innings after Hashim Amla (81).
Starts with a loopy one, full and around off, Imam quietly eases it towards long on and picks up a run.
Spin from both ends now. The debutant, Mitchell Swepson comes into the attack.
Full and flighted on middle, Babar gets forward and defends it from the inner half to mid-wicket.
Around off, a bit short, forced down to long on for a single.
Is that dropped? Short and wide outside off, Imam gets back to cut but gets a bottom edge. It falls in front of the keeper.
Too full in length and on off, knocked down to long on for one.
Short and on off, punched off the back foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Full and flighted around off, defended back to the bowler.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Adam Zampa is back on as well.
Another ball that is darted on the pads. Imam flicks it wide of the deep square leg fielder and yet again, comes back for the second run. Pakistan are 52/1 at the end of Powerplay 1!

On a length, around middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq nudges it behind square on the leg side, past Adam Zampa at short fine leg. Marcus Stoinis runs across to his left from deep square leg and cuts it off. The batters collect two runs.
Back of a length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq drops it towards backward point.
Excellent running between the wickets! A length ball, around middle and leg. Imam tucks it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder. He calls for the second run and gets it with ease in the end.
A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq leans and taps it towards backward point.
Short of a length, around off. Babar Azam defends it to the off side and sets off for a quick run.
This is a length ball, angling in from middle. Babar Azam flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off. Blocked out.

An appeal for run out and the decision has been sent upstairs. This is a length ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq tries to cut but it goes off the thick inside edge past the leg stump towards the keeper. Alex Carey half-stops it with a dive. The fielder at short fine leg collects the ball and scores a direct at the bowler's end as Imam looks to sneak in a run. The replays though suggest that Imam had made it home in time despite being lazy with his effort.
Back of a length, outside off. Babar Azam hangs back and slaps it through the cover region for a single.

FOUR! GLORIOUS! This is Babar Azam at his best! Green hurls a full ball, around off. Babar gets forward and drives it back past the bowler through mid on and bags a boundary. This shot might get him going.
Back of a length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq guides it towards third man and settles for a single.
Cameron Green (2-0-10-0) is back for his second spell.
Good-length delivery, shaping away from outside off. Babar pushes it awkwardly towards the mid off fielder.
Ellis hits the deck hard, around off. Babar Azam hangs back and blocks it towards cover.
On a length, just outside off. Babar Azam keeps it out.

EDGED AND FOUR! Ellis serves a length ball, angling in from outside off. Babar Azam stays back and looks to punch it through covers. He gets cramped for room and the ball flies off the outside edge, past the keeper and races away to the fence.
Back of a length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq taps it to the off side and scampers through to the other end.
Ellis begins with a full ball, around middle. Imam prods and pushes it towards mid on.
Nathan Ellis, on his ODI debut, is into the attack now. If you remember, he picked up a hat-trick on his T20I debut. Can he do something similar again?
Abbott drags his length back, just outside off. Babar gets on top of the ball and taps it gently towards backward point.
Good-length delivery, around the fourth stump channel. Babar defends it to the off side.
On a length, well outside off. Imam steers it to third man and rotates the strike.

FOUR! Well placed by Imam! Short of a length, around leg. Imam gets low and pulls it behind square on the leg side. The fielder there dives to his left to stop the ball, but he fails to do so. A welcome boundary for Pakistan.
On a length, outside off. Imam prods and pushes it without much timing towards mid off.
Back of a length, around leg, Imam-ul-Haq tucks it towards Aaron Finch at short fine leg with soft hands.
An overpitched ball, around middle. Babar Azam squeezes it out towards mid on. Just 3 runs off Zampa's first over.
Floated, around the pads. Babar tucks it behind square on the leg side and takes a couple of runs.
Flatter and quicker, going on with the angle from off. Babar sits back in his crease and wrists it to mid-wicket.
Zampa misses his length and serves it slightly short, around middle and leg. Imam rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Imam leans and blocks it out watchfully.
Zampa starts with a loopy ball, around middle. Imam keeps it out, on the leg side.
Time for some leg spin now as Aaron Finch brings Adam Zampa into the attack.
Back of a length, on off, Babar stands back and punches it to cover-point. Top over, 2 runs and a wicket from it.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and again pushes it to mid off.
Fuller and on off, Babar drives it down to mid off.
Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! A very important wicket for Australia. Just a bit of a dry spell mounted pressure and Fakhar Zaman, in a bid to find a boundary, falls. Clever change in pace from Abbott. He realizes that the batter is itching to get a boundary, so he slows it up at 128.8 kph and delivers it full and around middle and off. Fakhar Zaman shimmies down the track and tries to loft it over mid off but fails to get the desired elevation. A simple catch for Travis Head at the edge of the circle and Sean Abbott draws first blood.
Commentary.Howout: c Travis Head b Sean Abbott

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, around leg, it's nudged behind square leg for a run.
Abbott bowls short and around off, Fakhar plays a short-arm pull in front of square leg for a single.
Pitches it up and around off, Imam drives but picks out the mid off fielder.
Slightly short and around middle and leg, Imam uses his wrists to glance but finds the short fine leg fielder.
Lands it on a good length and outside off, Imam plays it with an angled bat to point.
Fullish and around off, from 'round the wicket, Fakhar plays the on drive and Head stops it with a slide at mid on. They cross.
FOUR! Gorgeous shot! Fuller in length and outside off, Fakhar transfers his weight into the drive, with lovely balance and creams it through the gap at extra cover for a boundary. Wow!
Play and a miss! Short in length and wide outside off, Fakhar throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Another full ball in the line of the stumps, Imam dead-bats it down on the surface.
Goes fuller and on middle, Imam flicks but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Short and on middle, Fakhar camps back and smacks it to deep square leg for a single.
Shortish and outside off, guided wide of backward point for one.
Taps a length ball down to covers and takes a single.
On a good length, around off, Fakhar stays back and plays it down to point.
FOUR! Imam opens his account. Short and on middle, Imam-ul-Haq stands tall inside the crease and pulls it effortlessly over square leg for a boundary.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
A touch short and on middle, Fakhar drags his shot wide of mid on for one.
Fuller and on off, Fakhar drives but not in the gap as he finds the cover fielder standing in the way.
Around off, on a good length, Fakhar covers the line and pushes it to mid off.
Green begins with a short delivery, outside off, Zaman cuts from the back foot but finds the point fielder.
Who will operate from the other end? Cameron Green it is.
Quick single. Fuller and on off, Fakhar drives it to extra cover and sets off for a single. He makes it in safely as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
On the pads, Fakhar plays it down in front of square leg. Dot ball.
Pulls his length back a bit and delivers it on middle, Zaman defends it from the crease to the on side.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries and this one is even better. Full and close to off, Fakhar Zaman presses forward and drives it crisply past mid off. The outfield is lightning quick and it races away to the fence. The crowd is making a lot of noise.
FOUR! Delightful! Abbott bowls it full and outside off, Fakhar leans forward and caresses it through the gap at covers for a boundary. Two players dived but the ball sneaked through.
Sean Abbott begins with a good-length ball, in the channel outside off and angling away, Fakhar Zaman watches it closely and shoulders arms.
